hooks.text: 十二种以上士兵占用不同背包格数，有限空间中的排布直接决定防线强度
hooks.excerpt: With over 12 unique soldier types, you must strategically arrange your forces within a limited grid space—just like organizing a backpack—to fend off wave after wave of zombie attacks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 开战后士兵自动形成密集弹幕，玩家通过资源分配、站位与技能组合维持防线
hooks.excerpt: When battle begins, your soldiers automatically attack, forming a dense bullet hell firing net. Zombies surge from the beach ahead. You must allocate resources, position your troops wisely, and combine their skills to ensure your line holds.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 失败仍保留战斗资源，用于开箱、升王与士兵，并在八档难度中收集碎片进化单位
hooks.excerpt: Can’t get past a wave? No problem! Every battle earns you resources → open chests → upgrade the King and your soldiers. The game features 8 difficulty levels: Earn soldier shards with each run Upgrade existing soldiers Unlock higher-tier units
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
